reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 (agents), on all 69 tee, green and bunker rings on four photo years, the greens also on the contrast-stretched photo, with the registered guide plates and the deck check

accepted.tjusta-green-10: drawn by hand: the rim shows round the north end and down the north-west side on every photo year, the front is set where the 2021 leaf-off photo turns from green to dormant turf and the 2023 mowing pattern changes (uncertain by some 3 m), and the east side lies under the wood's shadow on all four years. A stated fault of the ground until someone stands on it
accepted.tjusta-tee-01-1: the laser's level platform under the OSM tee way; its mown deck at the north end is where the plate puts the yellow tee (0.1 m off). The ring takes in grass round the deck
accepted.tjusta-tee-02-1: level deck north of Kimstavägen with a striped box on it; the plate puts the yellow tee 1 m from its centre
accepted.tjusta-tee-02-2: a mown oval with markers on both photos; the edge is soft against the fairway
accepted.tjusta-tee-06-1: one deck for both tees (the card 127 and 121), level in the laser, by the yard: the mown rectangle (bare and reseeded on the May 2023 photo) and the round patch north-west of it on the same platform; the plate's tee is 1 m from it
accepted.tjusta-tee-10-1: the level patch in the clearing south of the row house, under crowns; the plate's yellow tee is 13 m east, in the same clearing
accepted.tjusta-tee-10-2: drawn on the photo: the round mown platform with a tee rectangle the plate's line passes; not level in the laser (6%), kept as drawn
accepted.tjusta-tee-11-1: a level deck under crowns at the head of the strip; the plate's yellow tee is 4 m off
accepted.tjusta-tee-12-2: a small level deck in shade; the plate draws a forward tee 4 m from it
accepted.tjusta-tee-14-1: a striped rectangular deck by the path, clear on both photos; the edge score is low only because the deck is mown like the field round it
accepted.tjusta-tee-16-1: a level deck under crowns at the foot of the middle corridor; the plate's yellow tee is 0.4 m from its centre
accepted.tjusta-tee-16-2: a mown deck visible on both photos, kept as the laser's platform

tjusta-tee-01-1.reason: Waisted, two-lobed outline about 20 m long: a pale mown rectangle shows only in the south-west lobe, a tree stands at the waist, and the north-east lobe reads as ordinary turf or a second deck, so the ring looks like two surfaces in one.
tjusta-tee-01-1.resolution: one level platform in the laser under OSM's tee way, 20 m long, narrowed at a tree; its mown rectangle at the south-west end is where the plate puts the yellow tee (0.1 m off) and the card length agrees within a metre. The north-east lobe is the same platform, mown as tee on the 2019 photo

tjusta-tee-06-1.reason: Waisted, two-lobed outline: the south-east lobe holds a pale rectangular deck, the north-west lobe is a separate blob of mid-green turf with no deck edge on either photo, so the ring covers two decks or a deck plus rough.
tjusta-tee-06-1.resolution: one level platform for both tees (the card gives 127 and 121 m): the mown rectangle, bare and reseeded on the May 2023 photo, and the round patch north-west of it, a paler mown round on the July 2019 photo. The plate's tee is 1 m from it

tjusta-tee-07-1.reason: Ring is about 25 m long on a mown strip that carries on past its top end; the only distinct pale deck is a rectangle of roughly 6 m in its middle, and its lower end is in tree shadow on both photos.
tjusta-tee-07-1.resolution: the laser's level platform, 26 m of mown tee strip, dark and even along its whole length on the April 2021 photo; the pale 6 m rectangle in its middle is a tee mat on it. The plate puts the yellow tee on it and the card length agrees

tjusta-tee-08-1.reason: Angular polygon with straight cut edges and a notch in its top edge, where neighbouring lines meet it; the mown turf inside continues unchanged past the line, so the outline follows no visible deck edge on either photo.
tjusta-tee-08-1.resolution: the lower part of one L-shaped mown deck, bright and sharp-edged on the 2025 and 2019 photos with their contrast stretched; the ring follows its mown edge on three sides, and the straight north edge is the division from the 15th hole's arm of the same deck (the plates put 8's tee here and 15's on the arm). At sheet scale the deck's edge does not show

tjusta-tee-09-2.reason: Bean-shaped line on a broad pale mown area; the turf inside and outside the line reads the same on both photos and no deck edge or rim matches the shape.
tjusta-tee-09-2.resolution: the laser's level platform on evenly mown ground: no photo year shows an edge, as the reviewer says, and none is claimed. The card's red length agrees within a metre

tjusta-tee-12-1.reason: Ring spans what look like two adjoining mown rectangles of different tone and slightly different angle on the tracing photo (two decks in one ring?); the older photo is wholly in tree shadow and cannot confirm either.
tjusta-tee-12-1.resolution: one mown tee strip 14 m by 5, a single bright oval with its own mowing rings on the July 2019 photo; the paler rectangle at its east end is the worn tee box (bare on the May 2023 photo), which the first ring held alone

tjusta-tee-12-2.reason: No deck visible on either photo: the tracing photo is in deep tree shadow under the line, and the leaf-off photo shows open, even turf there with no deck edge or rim.
tjusta-tee-12-2.resolution: a small level deck in the laser under the wood's edge; no photo year shows it, as the reviewer says. The plate draws a forward tee 4 m from it and the card's red length agrees within a metre

tjusta-tee-14-1.reason: Ring is about twice as deep as the deck: the pale mown strip lies along its lower half on both photos, and the upper half takes in darker turf or bank above it.
tjusta-tee-14-1.resolution: the laser's level platform, mown as tee over its whole depth on the July 2019 photo and dormant brown over the same rectangle in April 2021; in 2023 and 2025 the marked tee box is its lower half. The ring is the platform

tjusta-tee-15-1.reason: Angular polygon with straight cut edges; its bottom edge is a dead-straight line shared with a neighbouring ring and the pale mown turf continues across it, so the outline is a cut-out of a larger mown area rather than a deck edge.
tjusta-tee-15-1.resolution: the north arm of the L-shaped mown deck (see tee 08-1), bright and sharp-edged on the 2025 and 2019 photos stretched; the ring follows its mown edge, and its straight south edge is the division from the 8th hole's part

tjusta-tee-16-1.reason: Large irregular blob of roughly 12 by 18 m: only a small pale rectangle at its top end reads as a deck on the tracing photo, the rest lies on mid-green ground under and between crowns, and the older photo is wholly in shadow.
tjusta-tee-16-1.resolution: a level platform 12 m by 18 in the laser, under crowns on every photo year, so the laser is its only witness; the pale rectangle at its north end is the tee box, and the plate's yellow tee is 0.4 m from the platform's centre

tjusta-tee-17-1.reason: Keyhole outline: a pale rectangular deck at the top and a wider round lobe below it look like two surfaces in one ring (the mound on the older photo has the same keyhole shape, so it may be one two-part tee).
tjusta-tee-17-1.resolution: one two-part tee, as the reviewer allows: a single raised mound of this keyhole shape on the April 2021 photo and one platform in the laser, with a tee mat at its north-east end

tjusta-tee-18-1.reason: Years disagree: on the 2021 photo a dark mown deck fills only the north-east half of the line and the south-west half lies on grey unmown ground, while on the 2025 photo pale mown turf fills the whole line (deck lengthened since, or the ring overshoots).
tjusta-tee-18-1.fault: the deck was lengthened after the laser was flown: mown only in its north-east half in April 2021, over the whole ring from 2023. The terrain under its south-west half is the old ground (0.13 m off a plane). A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-tee-18-3.reason: Broad pale oval of about 16 by 11 m of very fine, even turf that reads as a putting surface (practice green?) rather than a tee deck; on the older photo the oval also appears to sit a couple of metres south of the line, whose top edge runs onto a pale band.
tjusta-tee-18-3.resolution: a level oval platform in the laser between the 17th green and the yellow tee, mown short on all four photo years. On the May 2023 photo it does not stand out from the mown ground round it, as every putting surface does that month, so it is a teeing ground and not a green; the card gives it no colour, and it carries no tee mark

tjusta-bunker-07-1.reason: Years disagree: tan sand fills the ring on the 2025 photo, but the 2021 photo shows no sand there, only pale ground with a faint circular mark.
tjusta-bunker-07-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (turf on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): the terrain has no bowl under it and it is drawn as flat sand. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-07-2.reason: Years disagree: tan sand fills the ring on the 2025 photo, but the 2021 photo shows turf with a pale streak and a dark ditch line and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-07-2.fault: built after the laser was flown (turf on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-11-1.reason: Years disagree: tan sand fills the ring on the 2025 photo, but the 2021 photo shows rough green vegetation and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-11-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (rough on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-13-1.reason: Years disagree: tan sand fills the ring on the 2025 photo, but the 2021 photo shows rough grass beside a mown edge and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-13-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (rough on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-13-2.reason: Years disagree: tan sand fills the ring on the 2025 photo, but the 2021 photo shows rough vegetation below mown stripes and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-13-2.fault: built after the laser was flown (rough on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

tjusta-bunker-16-1.reason: Years disagree: tan sand fills the ring on the 2025 photo, but the 2021 photo shows even pale turf under the line and no sand.
tjusta-bunker-16-1.fault: built after the laser was flown (turf on the April 2021 photo, sand in 2025): flat sand on the old ground. A newer laser flight puts it right

cannotTell.tjusta-tee-02-1: Irregular outline with a pointed north-east corner on a small pale square; the edge of the deck itself is not distinct from the surrounding mown turf on either photo at sheet scale, so I cannot say whether the south-west bulge is deck.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-04-2: Small round ring of about 5 m: the older photo is in deep shadow, and on the tracing photo the ring sits at the edge of a broad pale mown area with no rim of its own; only a small bright spot shows inside it on both photos.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-04-3: The south-west half of the ring is in tree shadow on the tracing photo, and the older photo shows grey dormant ground and a conifer shadow with no distinct deck edge; only the north-east end shows pale mown turf.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-09-1: Crown cover over the upper half on the tracing photo and shadow over the lower half on the older photo; a pale strip shows at the lower end on one and a grey patch at the upper end on the other, but the narrow, pointed 16 m outline cannot be checked along its length.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-11-1: Both photos are in deep tree shadow under the whole ring; no deck can be seen, and the club-shaped outline (a pad with a 3 m wide tail) cannot be checked against anything.
cannotTell.tjusta-tee-16-2: Stepped, irregular outline on pale turf; a tree-shadow line crosses it on the tracing photo and the older photo shows even pale ground, so the deck edge is not distinct enough to say whether the step is real.
